title: 1980 object sank in a northern Swedish lake, radar return in the mud
place_text: Lake 'Damaya', a national park in northern Sweden

tellings.quote:
I mean in 1980 there was a landing and
an object that um sank in a lake up in
the very north of Sweden called Damaya
>> and we have been there and we have radar
returns that something is in the mud.

plain: In 1980, the researcher Clas Svahn says, an object landed and then sank in a lake called Damaya in a national park in the far north of Sweden. Svahn says his group has been to the lake and picked up radar readings that show something lying in the mud at the bottom. If that is right, the object might still be down there.
